fee_notes: Royalty Fee is the greater of 6% of weekly Gross Sales or $300/week (min ~$1,200/month). A Surcharge of up to $10/week may be added for restaurants in states with additional reporting requirements (currently only New York). Advertising Fee is 4% of weekly Gross Sales: 1% to National Fund and 3% to Regional Fund/Cooperative. Data Fee (POS polling) up to $75/month. POS Help Desk Phone Support Maintenance Contract Fee: $55/month. Gift Card Redemption Fee: 11% of redemption amount. Online ordering fees vary by structure: either (i) 10% of online order sale + $0.50 dispatch per order, or (ii) $60/month + $0.50 dispatch per order. Online ordering activation fee: one-time $250. During breach/default, Royalty Fee may increase up to 18% of Gross Sales or 3x the fixed Royalty Fee ("Breaching Royalties"), charged for a minimum 14-day period. Management Fee of 6% of Gross Sales (in addition to Royalty and Advertising Fee) applies if franchisor assumes management of the business.
raw_excerpt: Royalty Fee and Surcharge (Notes 1 and 9): Royalty Fee is the greater of the following: (i) 6% of total weekly Gross Sales or (ii) $300 per week. Surcharge is a maximum of $10 per week in addition to the Royalty Fee. (Note 2) | Advertising Fees (Note 1): 4% of weekly Gross Sales. | Data Fees (Notes 1 and 6): Up to $75 per month (subject to reasonable annual and/or service enhancement increases) | POS Help Desk Phone Support Maintenance Contract Fee: $55 per month | Gift Card Redemption Fee: Currently 11% of the amount of the gift card redemption | Online ordering activation fee: Currently, one-time fee of $250 | Online ordering fees with credit card payment: $0.07 per transaction plus online fee of $0.02 per each credit card transaction | Online ordering fees: (i) 10% of online order sale plus $0.50 dispatch per order, or (ii) $60 per month plus $0.50 dispatch per order | Management Fee: Six percent (6%) of the Franchised Business' Gross Sales (in addition to the Royalty Fee and Advertising Fee) plus our direct out-of-pocket costs and expenses.
